ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, it is known that $\angle AOB=90^\circ$, $\angle BOC=30^\circ$, $OM$ bisects $\angle AOC$, and $ON$ bisects $\angle BOC$. What is the measure of $\angle MON$ in degrees?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $\angle AOB = 90^\circ$ and $\angle BOC = 30^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle AOC = 90^\circ + 30^\circ = 120^\circ$,\\
since OM bisects $\angle AOC$,\\
we have $\angle AOM = \frac{1}{2} \angle AOC = \frac{1}{2} (\angle AOB + \angle BOC) = \frac{1}{2} \times 120^\circ = 60^\circ$,\\
since ON bisects $\angle BOC$,\\
it follows that $\angle CON = \frac{1}{2} \angle BOC = \frac{1}{2} \times 30^\circ = 15^\circ$,\\
thus, $\angle MON = \angle AOC - \angle AOM - \angle CON = 120^\circ - 60^\circ - 15^\circ = \boxed{45^\circ}$.
